description: Ministry of Highways Higher Education & Investment Promotion - The National Thoroughfares (Colombo - Katunayake User Fee National Highway) Regulations No. 1 of 2015 - Electronic User Fee Collection System
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It establishes legal and regulatory frameworks for user fees, payment methods, enforcement mechanisms, and penalties for non-compliance on the Colombo-Katunayake User Fee National Highway. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements.
